The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates to the Continental Congress. The most famous signers include:

| Signer | State |
|--------|-------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| George Washington | Virginia |
| James Madison | Virginia |
| Alexander Hamilton | New York |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| John Jay | New York |
| John Witherspoon | New Jersey |
| ... | ... |

(For a complete list, you can refer to the official records of the Continental Congress.)
